items.text: Inline edit focus — long-press editor uses a nearly opaque panel (96% background) and a tour-like full-page blur overlay so labels and fields stay readable on glass and launcher layouts.
Collections unsaved dot (C14) — editing Collections lights Extras ● without marking System dirty; autosave syncs the snapshot and clears group dots.

Reduced motion (C15) — prefers-reduced-motion and Reduce animations also disable tag-cloud word motion, keyboard rebind pulse, health-link shimmer, reorder highlights, theme-preview dot, and settings-search promo animations.
